heroHeadline: Day 655: El Mayo Sentencing Postponed to July 20; SEMAR Dismantles Mayito Flaco Drug Lab in Culiacán; US-Mexico Extradition Standoff Deepens
heroSubtitle: 655 days of cartel civil war — May 8: Judge Brian Cogan postponed El Mayo Zambada's EDNY sentencing for the third time, from May 18 to July 20, 2026 — reducing immediate diplomatic pressure but extending uncertainty over what revelations his court proceedings may bring. On the same day, SEMAR dismantled a clandestine narco-laboratory in Culiacán attributed directly to 'Mayito Flaco' Zambada Sicairos (El Mayo's son, La Mayiza's emerging leader), seizing industrial reactors, 200L of chemicals, and destroying 2,500 marijuana plants. May 9: Sheinbaum under pressure from all sides — Mexico demands 'irrefutable evidence' before extraditing indicted Sinaloa officials; SRE delivered diplomatic note to US DOJ. CBC News investigation reveals DEA probe into Chapitos' alleged tiger killings was the key evidence thread that built the historic Rocha Moya case. Bonilla Valverde governing Sinaloa; FGR's 50-official investigation proceeding. Running conflict toll: ~2,425+ since Sep 9, 2024.
